memories.summary: Mara's mother was admitted to hospital overnight on 2026-06-15 after her atrial fibrillation flared up; her brother Chidi caught it early.
Mara booked a flight to Lagos for July to visit her mother, deciding on 2026-06-15 after telling herself all spring she couldn't afford it.
Mara decided to take unpaid leave to visit her mother in Lagos because she needs to see her in person rather than over video; she stopped negotiating with herself about the cost.
Priyanka approved Mara's July time-off request for the Lagos trip without pushback.

entities.name: Priyanka
entities.description: Mara's manager/supervisor who approves her time off

memories.summary: Mara throws pots (does pottery) as a way to stay sane during stressful periods, planning to do so before her July trip.
